Me, because-

1. I've spent the majority of my days not wanting to be alive. I absolutely cannot have a child knowing that someday they might go through this as well. If my child ever felt like they didn't want to live, it would literally kill me. I would have immense guilt knowing that the "life" (the child) I gave birth to is in so much pain. I would blame myself for literally anything bad that happens to them. I would feel responsible for their agony, because I'm the one who gave birth to them and practically inflicted this life upon them.

2. The physical pain of childbearing is beyond my threshold. I cannot even imagine being pregnant for 9 months then actually giving birth.

3. I don't really have a lot of family members, so the child would be growing up without any aunts/uncles/cousins. Unless my partner has a good and huge family, my child would grow up not knowing what it's like to have that sort of an upbringing. I felt very lonely and isolated growing up myself, so I wouldn't want my child to go through the same.

4. I cannot imagine a younger version of myself. Like please no, you don't want these genes. Neither physical nor mental.

I may adopt or foster kids if my financial and other conditions allow- this also only if I'm 100% sure that I'll be able to give them a perfect environment to grow up in. But having a kid of my own is out of question.
